verdict.rationale: Bulk action is implied rather than documented. Broadcasts queue a message to every recipient in a list and can be triggered with a single API call, and segments let automations act on many profiles at once. The MCP server and CLI claim AI agents and scripts can do anything possible in the UI, including working with segments and one-time sends. Missing for 10: an explicit batch/bulk API endpoint for updating or deleting many profiles or objects at once, documentation of agent-driven bulk edits across many items, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
